name: v2.1.0
body:
## Security fixes

v2.1.0 fixes eight vulnerabilities in three servers. Upgrade
`@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` and `@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything`
to 2.0.1, and `mcp-server-fetch` to 2026.10.24.

| Package | Affected | Fixed in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` | 1.0.0 through 2.0.0, and date versions through 2026.8.31 | 2.0.1 |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything` | 1.0.0 through 2.0.0, and date versions 2025.9.24 through 2026.8.31 | 2.0.1 |
| `mcp-server-fetch` | through 2026.10.19 | 2026.10.24 |

### `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` 2.0.1

* **Writes stay inside the directory that was checked** (Linux and macOS). A parent directory swapped for a symlink between the access check and the write can no longer redirect `write_file`, `edit_file`, `create_directory` or the `move_file` destination outside the allowed directories. **On Windows this is only partly fixed**; the advisory says what is still exposed and how to configure around it ([GHSA-53mr-w429-c597](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-53mr-w429-c597))
* **Paths are checked exactly as they are used.** The access check no longer strips a trailing quote or whitespace that the file operation keeps, so a sibling directory named after an allowed one with that suffix is no longer reachable ([GHSA-7rgq-gccq-qphx](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-7rgq-gccq-qphx))
* **A symlink spelled in a different letter case no longer passes the symlink check** for a new path on a case-insensitive volume, such as macOS's default. This was a regression in 2026.8.31 ([GHSA-4gxg-m5jx-9j57](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-4gxg-m5jx-9j57))
* **`list_directory_with_sizes` checks each entry before reading its size**, so a symlink inside an allowed directory no longer reveals the size and modification time of a file outside it ([GHSA-hhwq-wxfx-cj7g](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-hhwq-wxfx-cj7g))

### `@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything` 2.0.1

* **The HTTP and SSE transports refuse requests from other web origins.** They now check the `Origin` header and no longer send `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, so a web page the user visits can no longer call the server's tools (such as `get-env`) or read their results ([GHSA-mvf5-2qqv-rg3c](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-mvf5-2qqv-rg3c))

### `mcp-server-fetch` 2026.10.24

* **The address check and the connection use the same host name.** For an internationalized (IDNA) host name, the server used to check one form of the name and connect to another, which could reach an internal address ([GHSA-v38p-wf49-hx2j](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-v38p-wf49-hx2j))
* **NAT64 addresses are judged by the IPv4 address they carry.** An address in `64:ff9b::/96` that wraps a private, loopback or link-local IPv4 address is now refused, as an IPv4-mapped one already was ([GHSA-66qx-2266-pmj6](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-66qx-2266-pmj6))
* **robots.txt is checked again after every redirect**, not only for the URL first requested ([GHSA-3jqg-r5pp-rmp2](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/security/advisories/GHSA-3jqg-r5pp-rmp2))

### Upgrading from a date-versioned npm release

The TypeScript servers moved from date versions (2025.x, 2026.x) to semantic versions in 1.0.0. Package managers rank 2.0.1 below every 2025.x and 2026.x version, so they won't offer it as an upgrade. If you are on a date version, install 2.0.1 explicitly, for example `npm install @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@2.0.1`.

## Packages

| Package | Version | Registry | In this release |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything` | `2.0.1` | npm | **published** |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem` | `2.0.1` | npm | **published** |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory` | `2.0.0` | npm | unchanged |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking` | `2.0.0` | npm | unchanged |
| `mcp-server-fetch` | `2026.10.24` | PyPI | **published** |
| `mcp-server-git` | `2026.10.19` | PyPI | unchanged |
| `mcp-server-time` | `2026.10.19` | PyPI | unchanged |

Release ledger: [v2/chore/5243-release-v2.1.0](https://claude.ai/artifact/KRKhZfRxCMpwsUBSyPw1n3)

* chore(fetch): bump certifi to 2026.10.19 in uv.lock (GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2) by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5244

## Repository

* docs(skills): keep argument placeholders out of skill bodies by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5220
* ci: dispatch DCO and the Everything diff on version PRs opened by automation by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5222
* docs: link the Version Packages PR to its release issue, not only by comment by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5221

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/compare/v2.0.0...v2.1.0

## Thanks for helping us improve

This release addresses vulnerabilities reported by these community members. Thank you for taking the time to report them:

* @0xCoDSnet (GHSA-4gxg-m5jx-9j57, GHSA-3jqg-r5pp-rmp2)
* @cybercraftsolutionsllc (GHSA-hhwq-wxfx-cj7g)
* @dizconnectz (GHSA-v38p-wf49-hx2j)
* @ehudmelzer (GHSA-mvf5-2qqv-rg3c)
* @golang-not-rust (GHSA-53mr-w429-c597)
* @HunterX461 (GHSA-7rgq-gccq-qphx)
* @LeonMAG (GHSA-66qx-2266-pmj6)
* @pacocartones (GHSA-66qx-2266-pmj6)

And to this contributor, whose prototyped fix ships in this release:

* @ace-ify, the platform-independent EISDIR assertion for #5162, shipped as #5246

This release refactors all the servers to support the modern era spec, while still answering legacy era clients as expected.

* feat: modern-era TypeScript servers (2026-07-28 + 2025) and the new features in everything by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5131
* fix(sequentialthinking): pad the thought box's header row to the border by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5144
* ci: validate the TypeScript servers on Node 22, 24 and 26 in parallel by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5147
* chore: version packages by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5100
* fix: raise the TypeScript servers' Node floor to 24 by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5169
* Release v2.0.0: merge v2/main into main by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5166

## Python servers: changes for clients

`mcp-server-fetch`, `mcp-server-git` and `mcp-server-time` have no CHANGELOG, so here is what changes for a client in `2026.10.19`. They are now built on the MCP Python SDK's high-level `MCPServer` ([#5175](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5175)).

- **Unknown tool:** a JSON-RPC `-32602` error (`Unknown tool: <name>`) in both protocol eras, as the spec requires. It used to be an `isError` result.
- **Tool errors** read `Error executing tool <name>: <message>`. Argument-validation errors now use pydantic's wording. Both are still `isError` results.
- **Capabilities:** each server now advertises `prompts` and `resources` capabilities (with `listChanged: false`). fetch's `fetch` prompt is the only entry in those lists.
- **time:** `get_current_time` and `convert_time` declare an `outputSchema` and return `structuredContent`. The text content is unchanged.
- **fetch:** a `prompts/get` result's `description` is now always the prompt's registered description.
- **Requires** `mcp>=2.3,<3`.

## mcp-server-fetch 2026.10.19

### What's Changed

* Port fetch, git and time to the MCP Python SDK v2 by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5062

* chore: stamp Python CalVer versions for 2026.10.18 by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5165
* Python servers: build fetch, git and time on MCPServer; unknown tool is -32602 by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5175
* chore: stamp Python CalVer versions for 2026.10.19 by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5177
* Release v2.0.0: merge v2/main into main by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5166
